newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' bellwether 91-day T-bill rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' bellwether 91-day T-bill rate falls.

text.p: The Philippines' benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate fell to 11.570 percent from last week's 12.029 percent at the regular weekly auction of government securities, the Bureau of Treasury said on Monday.
The weekly T-bills auction was swamped with bidders.
The three-month bills attracted bids worth 4.5627 billion pesos. The auction committee accepted only 1.5 billion pesos worth, the weekly allocation for the 91-day bills.

The 182-day T-bill rate likewise declined to 11.938 percent from last week's 12.415 percent. A total of 11.455 billion pesos worth of tenders was received, of which only 2.0 billion pesos were accepted.
The 364-day T-bill rate fell to 12.541 percent from last week's 13.015 percent.
The auction committee received 7.863 billion pesos worth of bids, but only 2.5 billion pesos were accepted.
